page_title: HAV 1-1 ETI | Le Havre v St Etienne 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' The referee shows the yellow card to Lamine Fomba (St Etienne).
90+2' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) for Lucas Stassin.
90+1' Here is a change. Yvann Macon is going off and Eirik Horneland gives the last tactical orders to Dennis Appiah (St Etienne).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Close effort! Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
89' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
88' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is out of play. St Etienne will take a throw-in.
85' The substitution is prepared. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Josue Casimir.
85' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Issa Soumare and he is replaced by Timothee Pembele (Le Havre).
84' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
82' Here comes a substitution. Benjamin Bouchouari is given a rest as he is replaced by Lamine Fomba (St Etienne).
81' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
79' Le Havre take a short corner kick.
78' St Etienne are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' St Etienne work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

75' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) quickly gets to a rebound somewhere around the penalty spot and attempts a header. His effort might have ended up in the net, but one of the defenders was well positioned on the goal line and knocked the ball away. St Etienne will take a corner kick.
75' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Leo Petrot (St Etienne). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
74' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. St Etienne can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
70' Gautier Larsonneur reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) low towards the middle of the goal.
67' That's the end of the game for Ahmed Hassan, who is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
67' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Mahamadou Diawara will be replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
65' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
65' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.
64' St Etienne seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
62' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
62' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. St Etienne force their opponents to concede a corner.
62' A long ball forward to Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) is intercepted.
61' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aimen Moueffek.

58' Le Havre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

55' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
54' Le Havre are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
51' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Mathieu Gorgelin has no trouble gathering it.
51' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. St Etienne will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) for his blatant foul.

48' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre. Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
47' St Etienne take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

47' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for St Etienne.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Irvin Cardona (St Etienne), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
45+1' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) attempts to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty kick. Unfortunately for him, he blows it.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) probably handled the ball. PENALTY to Le Havre!
43' The corner from Leo Petrot (St Etienne) is intercepted by the defence.

43' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. St Etienne have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
42' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
39' A pass by Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' A cross into the box from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is cleared.
34' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Gautier Larsonneur gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
32' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sees a yellow card from Clement Turpin after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
31' CHANCE! Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the left post!
31' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
30' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
28' Gautier Larsonneur makes a brilliant save! Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.
28' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

26' It looked like the long-range shot by Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
26' Mickael Nade (St Etienne) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
22' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
22' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
22' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. St Etienne win a free kick.
20' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

20' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Le Havre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

18' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
16' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fode Ballo-Toure leaves the pitch and Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) comes on.
15' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The St Etienne players look gutted.
14' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The St Etienne players aren’t happy.

13' An amazing individual effort from Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 0:2. Mathieu Gorgelin was helpless.
12' That was close by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
8' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
5' Wonderful movement by St Etienne. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
3' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) tackles a bit over-zealously and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Le Havre will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Clement Turpin.
